<div class="card-body">
'''Death Star: Trench''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊デス・スター：トレンチ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここでは“トレンチ・ルール”が適用され、自分の兵器はフォースなしで起動できる。またここに「ターボレーザー砲塔」を配備できる。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここでは“トレンチ・ルール”が適用され、自分の宇宙戦闘機の回避値は－2。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Death-Star-Trench-PSA-159081597.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Star: Trench.

'''Light Side:'''
Trench Rules apply here, and your weapons may fire for free. You may also deploy Turbolaser Battery here.

'''Dark Side:'''
Trench Rules apply here, and the maneuver of your starfighters is −2.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese Light has free weapons and Turbolaser Battery; English puts those on Dark.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star: Trench]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
